steps.en: Pull and start NVIDIA's release container on an NVIDIA GPU host
steps.zh: 在 NVIDIA GPU 主机上拉取并启动 NVIDIA 的正式版容器

steps.en: Serve a Hugging Face model, optionally one NVIDIA already quantized to FP8
steps.zh: 服务 Hugging Face 模型，可选 NVIDIA 量化好的 FP8 版

steps.en: Loads the checkpoint directly into PyTorch and starts a worker per GPU rank
steps.zh: 把 checkpoint 直接载入 PyTorch，每张卡起一个工作进程

steps.en: Each step: schedules requests, reserves KV cache, runs NVIDIA's kernels, samples tokens
steps.zh: 每步调度请求、留 KV 缓存、跑 NVIDIA 内核、采样

component.zh: 调度器 + KV 缓存管理器

steps.en: Send OpenAI-format requests from your existing client
steps.zh: 用现有客户端发送 OpenAI 格式的请求

steps.en: Streams the answers back at NVIDIA-tuned throughput
steps.zh: 以 NVIDIA 调优过的吞吐把回答返回

value.en: NVIDIA's own GPU optimizations behind a standard OpenAI API, without building per-GPU engines
value.zh: 标准 OpenAI API 背后就是 NVIDIA 自家的 GPU 优化，不用再为每种 GPU 构建引擎

sources: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/blob/main/docs/source/developer-guide/overview.md (LLM class, PyExecutor per rank: Scheduler, KVCacheManager, ModelEngine, Sampler)
https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/blob/main/docs/source/legacy/tensorrt-backend-removal.md (no engine-build step; Hugging Face checkpoints load directly)
